name: Emulation
short: Native emulated synthesizers, console APUs and Wurlitzer
long: Opale (OPL2/OPL3), AYstral (AY/YM/Sega PSG), SIDérant (SID 6581/8580), Wurlie (Wurlitzer 200A), SiCC (SCC/SCC+/HuC6280 wavetable), and Consolated (NES/Game Boy APUs). Native score controls, automation and global volume, with presets in score's user library; no hardware-panel replicas. No manufacturer ROMs or third-party banks are bundled.
